resources.string: GTBike V settings from its configuration file on the PC (gtbikev.com → Configuration). GTBike V rewrites that file while GTA V runs, so these change only with the game closed and apply the next time it starts. Weight, FTP, difficulty, Road Feel, bike and character change live in Profile and ride.
GTA V is running on the PC. Close the game to change these options (GTBike V would overwrite them). They apply the next time it starts.
GTA V is closed: you can change these options. They apply the next time you start the game. A backup is kept on the PC.
Unsaved changes. Tap Save; they apply the next time you start GTA V.
GTBike V\'s configuration file was not found on the PC. Start GTA V with GTBike V once so it creates it.
The PC app is older than this phone app. Update GTAV Riding Companion on the PC to change game options.
The file changed on the PC since it was loaded. Tap Discard to reload it, then make your changes again.

resources.string: 100% shows no cars; 0% leaves the traffic as GTA V makes it.
Riders that join you on a route, up to 5. Set them all to 0 for no bots.
Defensive: anyone aggressive close by dies. Aggressive: anyone too close who is not on a bike dies or their vehicle explodes.
For the A and D steering keys on the PC. 1 steers fully.
Size 0 hides them. A route\'s own settings take precedence.
Use the offset with several monitors when GTA V is not on the main one: the main screen\'s width, or negative if the game screen is to its left.
